# ad-copy-agency-skill

> Open-source Claude Code skill (skill name: copy-masters) for AI ad copywriting. It runs an ad agency workflow with one agent per role: client brief, raw material collection, planner's creative brief, creative director's brief review ("creative surgery"), three creative teams writing in sequence, two CD review rounds with rework and defense, and a client review with fact and advertising-law checks. Output is a final headline, two alternates and a process check. Prompts and copy are in Korean.

Install: `git clone https://github.com/5hyuns/ad-copy-agency-skill.git ~/.claude/skills/copy-masters`, then call `/copy-masters` in Claude Code with subject, business goal, target, mode (performance or brand), channel (social feed, search ads, landing page, video script) and brand name. Requires Python 3.

Honest limit: in head-to-head tests against a single prompt given the same material, its final lines won 0.37 of the time on average. Its value is a traceable process and fact checking, not better copy.
